fusions.name: Headlong Charge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to the target and strike it, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.8 times as much if it was at long range.

fusions.name: Loosed Scree
fusions.desc: Hurls a stone that costs 4% of your maximum health and deals 8 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Ground
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Footing
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
